title: Turner Sketches Durham Cathedral
content: During his 1801 trip north toward Scotland,J. M. W. Turner(1775-1851) filled seven sketchbooks. In one of them, he captured the changing light over Durham Cathedral after a rainstorm.Durham Cathedral with Castle and Rainbow, 6.5 x 4.5 inchesThe castle and cathedral are half in light and half in shadow, with a dark foreground.Durham Cathedral with Castle and Rainbow, 6.5 x 4.5 inchesA few minutes later, in the same sketchbook, he notated a different effect, with the light focused on the middle ground.-----More at the Tate Museum websiteThese two sketches appear in the bookTurner's Early Sketchbooks: Drawings in England, Wales and Scotland from 1789-1802Another book on the topic is:Turner's Sketchbooks, a 2018 paperback from the Tate.
